description: GET /search/code, GitHub code-search syntax (e.g. "repo:owner/name path:src language:ts <terms>"). Without `repo:owner/name` in `q` it searches all public code on GitHub plus the private repositories the connected accounts can see; put `repo:owner/name` in `q` to search one repository. GitHub indexes only the default branch. Results merge across accounts.

per_page.description: Results per page (GitHub's default is 30, max 100).
